<ul><li><b>La sala</b> es un grupo priva:
• The room is a private group: anyone with the code or the link can join. Up to 12 players.
  • Messages: positions, chat and cards travel through two public messaging servers (EMQX and HiveMQ) at the same time, in case one fails. They're encrypted with the room code: the servers can't read them.
  • Voice: goes straight between the browsers (WebRTC). On some networks (4G with some operators, office wifi) a direct connection isn't possible: the rest of the game keeps working.
  • Nothing is saved: when you close the page you leave the room. Your personal card stays in your browser.
